einzeiler: Listeners share real paranormal stories featuring ghosts, cryptids, and haunting…
kurzfassung: In this special encounters episode with no fixed theme, the hosts read listener-submitted stories covering a wide variety of paranormal experiences. Tales include haunted childhood homes with mischievous spirits, dangerous paranormal games played in basements, dark cult rituals, urban legends, and unexplainable creatures. The episode highlights terrifying encounters and the lasting spiritual impact these events leave on those who survive them.
stichpunkte: A listener shares memories of a haunted childhood home where a ghost repeatedly changed the television to a porn channel.
Teenagers playing the dangerous paranormal game Red Door, Yellow Door in a basement encounter a terrifying smiling man entity.
A listener recounts growing up in a religious cult involving animal sacrifices, possessions, and intense psychological trauma.
Another listener describes a terrifying face-to-face encounter with the urban legend La Llorona during a trip to Texas.
A traveler shares a sighting of a massive white, dragon-like creature gliding over mountain roads in Honduras.
A harrowing apartment complex haunting involving a secretive upstairs neighbor who carved demonic sigils into the floorboards.
The hosts discuss the unpredictability of listener-submitted stories when opening the inbox to a 'kitchen sink' format.

clips.text: The hosts discuss the challenges of using dating apps in a relatively small city like Boston where options feel limited.

clips.hook: Blindly trusting paranormal rules found online
clips.text: The speakers reflect on the inherent danger of blindly following internet instructions for supernatural games without knowing the true motives behind them.

clips.hook: A terrifying ritual led by a man in white
clips.text: A detailed description of a ritual leader wearing all white who smoked cigars, sipped from a metal cup, and chanted in a foreign language.

clips.hook: The omnipresent nature of La Llorona
clips.text: The hosts emphasize that unlike localized legends tied to a single bridge, this specific entity can appear anywhere near bodies of water, even in a bathtub.

clips.hook: Spotting a massive white flying creature
clips.text: The narrator describes frantically urging a friend to look out the bus window as a giant white wing-flapping entity vanishes behind a mountain peak.

beschreibung:
It’s a kitchen sink episode, and we’re throwing everything paranormal at you! We’ve got haunted houses, dark entities, paranormal games gone wrong, La Llorona, a possible dragon sighting, a porn-addicted ghost and more.

Stories include:

A haunted childhood home brings night terrors, sleep paralysis, two sinister black cats, and a ghost that repeatedly changes the TV to an inappropriate channel.

A game of Red Door, Yellow Door in a haunted basement unleashes a terrifying smiling man who appears in dreams and seems to follow the players beyond the game.

A childhood spent attending disturbing nighttime rituals leads to terrifying dreams, sleep paralysis, a shared encounter with a demonic entity, and a long battle to break free.

La Llorona appears after a mysterious wail is heard outside on the night a pregnancy is discovered.

A terrifying apartment haunting features night terrors, shadow figures, scratches, blood seemingly dripping from the walls, demonic symbols, and an entity known as the Crawler.
